items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: We had a very dear friend during the World War II days in Valparaiso, Florida. ... He was Dr. Arthur David.

ctx.x: We even have one of our teachers over there plays clarinet and saxophone.

Many do. Many played their way through universities with black sticks. Mm-hmm. We had a very dear friend during the World War II days in Valparaiso, Florida. One of the men has done a lot of research in the Rubin method of child delivery. He was Dr. Arthur David. He's, he played his way playing basketball and clarinet. That's how he worked his way through college. Mm-hmm. That's a fight. Or through medical school. And that's a very difficult thing to do. You know that yourself. I know. Or as your parents and your…
I even went to medical school all while myself. But I didn't like it.
